notes: nowcerts.com is client-rendered: the home and pricing pages gave 64 characters of text on the fetch, and in pass 2 both were read once in a real browser. The vendor publishes two live price lists: the legacy nowcerts.com pricing page (Essentials $99 a month with one user, $45 per additional user license, IVANS downloads $35; only the Essentials column rendered) and the current Momentum AMS pricing page at momentumamp.com/pricing, linked from the vendor's own rebrand post and read once in pass 2 (Essentials $119 one user, Professional $199 two users, Business $419 five users, $54 per additional seat, IVANS downloads $35 on the two entry plans). Claims that match either own price list are classed true with the matching page as proof and the other figure named in the rationale (C05, C07 against Momentum; C09, C14 against nowcerts.com); C12 ($169 Professional, cited to the legacy page) stays unverifiable because that column did not render. The rebrand post dates the rename from NowCerts to Momentum to 13 Nov 2024 and settles C01 to C04. Not coded: Capterra ratings, IIABA market share figures, fit opinions (most affordable, fastest-growing entrant), open-API and certificate features, the malformed q10 Google AI Overviews run 3 comparison table, and the hedged line about feature limitations or usage caps. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): C05, C06, C07, C08, C09, C10 (reworded to tiered flat pricing), C14, C17, C19 and C21 unverifiable to true; C13 unverifiable to wrong (starts at $169 against entry prices of $119 and $99), cause the cited quotesweep comparison (other); C11, C12, C15, C16, C18 and C20 stay unverifiable with new reasons. Added C22 and C23 from table cells (q4 ChatGPT 1, q1 ChatGPT 2); the gap lines were already covered at record level or were opinions. Page budget for this vendor: 7 of 14.
